# CoPantry

> AI-powered recipe manager and meal planner with a native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
> Website: https://www.copantry.com
> App: https://app.copantry.com
> API: https://api.copantry.com
> MCP Endpoint: https://api.copantry.com/mcp
> MCP Documentation: https://www.copantry.com/mcp

## What is CoPantry?

CoPantry is a household recipe management and meal planning application. It allows users to:

- **Import recipes** from any URL, photo, or raw text using AI extraction
- **Track pantry inventory** with ingredient quantities and expiry dates
- **Plan meals** on a household calendar with automatic pantry deduction on confirmation
- **Generate shopping lists** from their meal plan
- **Share everything** with household members in real time

CoPantry is available as a web app at https://app.copantry.com and as a native Android application. The UI supports English, French, Italian, and Portuguese. Recipe content stays in its original language.

## MCP Server

CoPantry operates a production-ready Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. This allows AI assistants (including Claude, GPT-based tools, Perplexity, Cursor, Windsurf, and any MCP-compatible client) to interact with a user's household data on their behalf.

### MCP Endpoint

- **URL**: https://api.copantry.com/mcp
- **Transport**: Streamable HTTP (stateless, JSON responses)
- **Auth**: Bearer token — API key generated at https://app.copantry.com/settings/mcp
- **SDK**: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk v2.0 (official Anthropic MCP TypeScript SDK)
- **Scope**: Each API key is scoped to one household

### Quick Setup (Claude Desktop)

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "Copantry": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://api.copantry.com/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer <user-api-key>"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### Available MCP Tools

The CoPantry MCP server exposes 10 tools across 4 categories. All tools operate on the authenticated user's household data.

---

#### Category: Recipes

**search_recipes**
- Purpose: Search the household's recipe collection by title keyword and/or category.
- When to use: To find recipes before retrieving full details, checking what's available, or suggesting meal options.
- Parameters:
  - `search` (string, optional): Partial or full recipe title match (case-insensitive).
  - `category` (enum, optional): One of APPETISER, STARTER, MAIN, DESSERT, COCKTAIL, CAKE, SIDE, BREAKFAST, SOUP, SNACK.
- Returns: Array of up to 20 recipe summaries with id, title, category, language, createdAt.

**get_recipe_details**
- Purpose: Retrieve a complete recipe including all ingredients (with quantities and units) and step-by-step instructions.
- When to use: After search_recipes, when the user needs full recipe content before cooking or planning a meal.
- Parameters:
  - `id` (string UUID, required): Obtained from search_recipes or get_meal_plan.
- Returns: Full recipe object with ingredients, instructions, servings, prepTime, cookTime, comments.

**scrape_recipe**
- Purpose: Queue a public URL for AI-powered recipe extraction. The recipe appears in the collection within ~60 seconds.
- When to use: When the user wants to add a recipe from any website, YouTube video, Instagram, or TikTok post.
- Parameters:
  - `url` (string URL, required): Fully-qualified public URL of the recipe page.
- Returns: Confirmation that the recipe has been queued.

---

#### Category: Pantry

**list_pantry**
- Purpose: List all items currently in the household pantry, sorted by expiry date (soonest first).
- When to use: To audit stock, plan waste-free meals, or answer "what do I have?" questions.
- Parameters:
  - `expiredOnly` (boolean, optional): If true, returns only expired items. Default: false.
- Returns: Array of pantry items with id, ingredient name, quantity, unit, expiryDate.

**add_pantry_item**
- Purpose: Add a new ingredient to the household pantry with optional quantity, unit, and expiry date.
- When to use: When the user has bought groceries or wants to log produce with an expiry date.
- Parameters:
  - `name` (string, required): Ingredient name, singular form. Server normalises casing and pluralisation.
  - `quantity` (number, optional): Numeric amount (e.g. 500 for grams).
  - `unit` (string, optional): Unit of measurement (e.g. "g", "ml", "cup", "piece").
  - `expiryDate` (string YYYY-MM-DD, optional): ISO-8601 expiry date.
- Returns: Confirmation with ingredient name, quantity, and unit.

**delete_pantry_item**
- Purpose: Remove a specific pantry item by its unique identifier.
- When to use: When the user discards, consumes, or incorrectly logged an item.
- Parameters:
  - `id` (string UUID, required): From list_pantry. Do not guess — always retrieve first.
- Returns: Confirmation of removal.

---

#### Category: Meal Planning

**get_meal_plan**
- Purpose: Retrieve planned meals for a date range from the household meal calendar.
- When to use: Before scheduling new meals, or to answer "what are we eating this week?"
- Parameters:
  - `startDate` (string YYYY-MM-DD, optional): Defaults to today.
  - `endDate` (string YYYY-MM-DD, optional): Defaults to 7 days from today.
- Returns: Array of calendar entries with id (calendarId), date, mealType, isConfirmed, and recipe details.

**plan_meal**
- Purpose: Schedule a specific recipe for lunch or dinner on a given date.
- When to use: After the user approves a meal suggestion. Verify the recipe exists first.
- Parameters:
  - `recipeId` (string UUID, required): From search_recipes.
  - `date` (string YYYY-MM-DD, required): Target date.
  - `mealType` (enum, required): LUNCH or DINNER.
- Returns: Confirmation with recipe title, meal type, and date.

**confirm_meal**
- Purpose: Mark a planned meal as cooked and automatically deduct its ingredients from the pantry (FIFO by expiry date).
- When to use: When the user has finished cooking. Deduction uses recipe's default quantities unless overridden.
- Parameters:
  - `calendarId` (string UUID, required): The meal calendar entry id from get_meal_plan.
  - `consumedIngredients` (array, optional): Override of {ingredientId, quantity} pairs for actual amounts consumed.
- Returns: Confirmation that the meal is confirmed and pantry is updated.

---

#### Category: Shopping

**get_shopping_lists**
- Purpose: Retrieve all shopping lists for the household, including all line items.
- When to use: When the user asks what to buy or wants to review their shopping plan.
- Parameters: None.
- Returns: Array of shopping lists with name, createdAt, and items (name, quantity, unit, checked).

---

### Built-in MCP Prompt

**plan_waste_free_week**
- Purpose: Guided prompt instructing the AI to review expiring pantry items and available recipes, then suggest a 7-day waste-minimising meal plan.
- When to use: When the user wants a comprehensive meal planning session.
- Parameters: None.

---

## Pricing

| Plan      | Price      | MCP Calls/Month |
|-----------|-----------|-----------------|
| Hobbyist  | Free      | 200             |
| Home      | $4.99/mo  | 3,000           |
| Family    | $9.99/mo  | 10,000          |
| Builder   | $29/mo    | 60,000          |

All plans include unlimited recipes, pantry items, and household members. MCP call limits only apply to programmatic AI assistant usage.
